messages:
Noah: Who's up for catching sunrise waves Saturday? 6:30am meet at North Shore. Surf, coffee, then maybe sleep the rest of the day. :surfing_man: :coffee:
Lina: 6:30am?? Is that a typo or are you trying to punish us for fun. Im tempted though. :yawning_face:
Omar: I can do sunrise but only if theres a coastal diner stop after. Greasy breakfast > bruised ego.
Bea: I vote snooze + bottomless brunch at 11 instead. My sleeping schedule is non-negotiable on weekends. :pancakes:
Noah: Quick check: reply S for surf, Z for snooze brunch. Ill pick based on majority and/or who brings a thermos.
Lina: Z (but I could be convinced with a convincing playlist and hot chocolate)
Omar: S (but Im the one bringing the greasy eggs)
Bea: Z
Noah: Looks like Z wins 2-1. Brunch it is. Tentative plan: gather at Sunny Diner at 11am. If anyone wakes up early and wants solo surf, ping here and well form a rogue crew.
event-bot: Event draft: "Saturday Brunch @ Sunny Diner" created by Noah 11:00 - 13:00. Attendees: Noah, Lina, Bea.
Omar: Ill still try to make the 6:30 surf but will probably nap through my alarm. If I dont show, eat an extra pancake for me.
Bea: Deal. If Omar makes it, he buys coffee. If he doesnt, we make fun of his alarm choice. :alarm_clock:
Lina: Ill bring my camera in case anyone actually surfs and doesnt just stand on the board dramatically.
Noah: Perfect. Brunch crew, see you at 11. Rogue surf crew, may the waves be merciful. :ocean:
